knownIssues.symptom: The office runs at about 18 to 27 fps on macOS 27, where it ran at 60 on macOS 26, and already on macOS 26.7 (21 fps there, highball#400)
Without the recipe, on a display whose logical resolution is not 16:10: the picture sits down and to the right with black bars along the top and left, and is clipped at the right and bottom edges.
On a 14-inch M1 Pro the game draws small in a corner of the screen and the mouse position does not match what it clicks (reported on 0.9.12, highball#67)

On the Wine 11 engines (x64-crossover26.3-r11, r12) under DXVK the game runs at about 40 fps with cut sound and uneven frames, against 76 fps on the default engine's DXVK Direct3D 9 (Metal HUD, menu, M1 Pro, macOS 27.0, 2026-09-25).
